answer: No, he doesn't need a notary. Form NW-POA-2 replaced the notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and it can be signed electronically with no notary. Only Georgia still requires notarization, and that doesn't apply in Virginia. An NW-POA-1 is no longer accepted because the cutoff for older ones was June 30, 2026, so have your dad sign NW-POA-2, and bring your own photo ID and the car's documents.
